message: Title length is outside the ideal range.
evidence: Men's Fashion | Shop Men Clothes Online At Affordable Prices – TRIPR

message: Title tag and H1 target different wording.
recommendation: Keep the title and H1 aligned while allowing the title to include brand or offer terms.
evidence: title=Men's Fashion | Shop Men Clothes Online At Affordable Prices; h1=TRIPR FASHION SALE

recommendation: Review repeated theme sections and app blocks.

message: Page has a high script count.
recommendation: Review app/theme JavaScript and defer non-critical scripts.

message: Page contains a high number of image tags.
recommendation: Review product galleries, collection cards, and hidden media blocks.

message: Page references many large Shopify image URLs.
recommendation: Serve appropriately sized responsive images and avoid loading large width variants below the fold.

message: Primary image appears to be lazy-loaded.
recommendation: Load the primary hero/product image eagerly for better LCP.

message: 11 duplicate image alt text value(s) found on the page.
recommendation: Use unique alt text when images show different angles, variants, colors, or details.
evidence: round neck plain t shirts (5) | pack of 2 mens cotton blend solid grey black trackpants (5) | solid men dark blue grey track pants pack of 2 (4) | men high neck plain full sleeve t shirts 8 variants (4) | pack of 2 mens printed trackpant...

message: Collection page does not expose FAQ content.
recommendation: Add helpful FAQs around sizing, fit, material, styling, delivery, and returns when useful for the category.

message: Collection page repeats many product links.
recommendation: Reduce duplicate product card links or repeated variant links so the collection page has a cleaner crawl path.

message: Page has no internal links from other crawled pages.
recommendation: Add internal links from navigation, collections, related products, blog articles, or other relevant pages.

message: Collection has no internal HTML links pointing to it.
recommendation: This collection has no internal HTML links pointing to it. Add it to a navigation menu or link it from a relevant page. Products assigned only to this collection will appear in the unreachable products report.
